test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Disability was viewed as God's **__retribution for wickedness__** in the past.
solution:
The correct answer is** "punishment for wrongdoing."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence suggests that disability was seen as a form of punishment.
 
• The punishment was believed to be inflicted by God.
 
• The reason for the punishment was believed to be wickedness in the past.
 
• So, the phrase "retribution for wickedness" can be replaced with the phrase "punishment for wrongdoing."
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Revenge for legal works"** does not make sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Payback for doing help"** is not related to the concept of punishment or disability.
 
• **"Fine for misbehaviour" **suggests a monetary penalty rather than a physical or spiritual punishment.
